name: A key in three pieces

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

summary: Khadgar explains that, while stranded in Outland, he split his key into three and hid the pieces inside enchanted containers. The places seemed safe when he chose them; Outland has changed since then. His explanation gives the search its shape, but not a single road: each fragment lies in a separate dungeon, and each location reflects a world now fought over by new powers.
